text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes things like understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from large amounts of data instead of following fixed rules. A more advanced area is deep learning, which uses complex networks inspired by the human brain to process information in layers. Today, AI is everywhere in daily life. It powers voice assistants, recommends videos or products online, filters spam emails, and helps doctors analyze medical scans. While AI offers great benefits, it also raises important questions about privacy and jobs.
